Use Rich's `Live` display to update terminal output; see [Live Display](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst). Rich renders strings as text and strips control characters such as carriage return, while its flush behavior only ensures rendered output is sent promptly. For help with a particular display, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
